wpPortfolio.title: BLOOM
wpPortfolio.content:
In September 2020, I built a slick, bespoke WordPress site for a fintech startup. It was designed using GatsbyJS for the front-end and WordPress for the CMS, enabling the client to update all the content on the site, In addition, GraphQL was used to pull all data into the site. I also used scrollmagic to create the interactive animations on the homepage and integrated an API which enables users to submit their phone number and receive a text message in return with details of how to download the company’s app. This work was completed under a NDA agreement, however I received the following testimonial from Bloom:

“Working with Paul was an absolute pleasure and I’d happily recommend him to anyone who needs an expert, safe pair of hands for their web development. He was exactly the right man for the job on a highly demanding project!” – Steph Melodia, MD, Bloom Ltd
